rule_text: PMFBY FAQ lists food crops (cereals, millets and pulses), oilseeds, and annual commercial/annual horticultural crops.
applies_to: Notified crops vary by state and season

rule_text: Individual farmer sum insured is Scale of Finance per hectare multiplied by insured area of the notified crop; area is expressed in hectares.
applies_to: Notified crop and area
deadline_or_rate: Scale of Finance × area in hectares

rule_text: FAQ states farmer share is 2% of sum insured or actuarial premium rate, whichever is less, for Kharif foodgrain and oilseed crops.
applies_to: Kharif foodgrain and oilseed crops
deadline_or_rate: 2% of SI or actuarial rate, whichever is less

rule_text: FAQ states farmer share is 1.5% of sum insured or actuarial premium rate, whichever is less, for Rabi foodgrain and oilseed crops.
applies_to: Rabi foodgrain and oilseed crops
deadline_or_rate: 1.5% of SI or actuarial rate, whichever is less

rule_text: FAQ states farmer share is 5% of sum insured or actuarial premium rate, whichever is less, for annual commercial/annual horticultural crops.
applies_to: Annual commercial/horticultural crops
deadline_or_rate: 5% of SI or actuarial rate, whichever is less

rule_text: FAQ describes cover when the majority of insured farmers in a notified area, who intended to sow and incurred expenditure, are prevented from sowing by adverse weather.
applies_to: Notified area and crop; conditions apply
deadline_or_rate: Up to 25% of SI as stated in FAQ

rule_text: FAQ describes cover for harvested crops left in cut-and-spread condition to dry in the field, up to 14 days after harvest.
applies_to: Eligible insured crop in field-drying condition
deadline_or_rate: Up to 14 days, subject to conditions

rule_text: FAQ identifies cyclone/cyclonic rains and unseasonal rains for post-harvest loss cover.
applies_to: Post-harvest crop in eligible drying condition

rule_text: FAQ describes individual-farm cover for identified localized risks such as hailstorm, landslide and inundation affecting isolated farms in a notified area.
applies_to: Insured notified crop and area
deadline_or_rate: Applicable reporting timeline must be checked

rule_text: FAQ lists natural fire/lightning, storms/hailstorm/cyclone, flood/inundation/landslide, drought/dry spells and pests/diseases.
applies_to: Standing crops on notified-area basis

rule_text: FAQ lists war and kindred perils, nuclear risks, riots, malicious damage, theft, act of enmity, animal damage and other preventable risks.
applies_to: Scheme exclusions; facts and policy conditions matter

rule_text: Revised Operational Guidelines section 21.4.3.1 says immediate intimation within 72 hours for the described post-harvest loss process.
applies_to: Cited post-harvest loss process; do not generalize to all claims

rule_text: Guidelines list insurer, concerned bank, local agriculture department/government or district officials, toll-free number, or NCIP for the cited process.
applies_to: Cited post-harvest loss process

rule_text: PMFBY portal homepage displays Krishi Rakshak Portal & Helpline 14447 for grievances and crop-loss reporting.
applies_to: Grievance support and crop-loss reporting guidance

rule_text: Whether a crop is eligible in a farmer's location depends on the crop and area notified by the state for that season.
applies_to: Specific state, district/insurance unit, crop and season

rule_text: FAQ page contains a Kharif 2016 last-date entry. It is historical and must not be used as a current deadline.
applies_to: Kharif 2016 only; current deadline is season/state-specific
deadline_or_rate: Do not use as current deadline

rule_text: FAQ says Scale of Finance is decided by the District Level Technical Committee and pre-declared/notified by the state-level committee.
applies_to: Specific crop and notified area/season
deadline_or_rate: Use official notified Scale of Finance

rule_text: FAQ says area under cultivation for sum-insured calculation is expressed in hectares.
applies_to: Sum-insured calculation

rule_text: 2020 Revamped Guidelines table says bank branch or government officials should forward farmer intimation to insurer within next 48 hours.
applies_to: Cited 2020 process; confirm later amendments

rule_text: 2020 Revamped Guidelines table describes payment within 15 days from receipt of loss assessment report, subject to advance first instalment of central and state subsidy.
applies_to: Cited process and subsidy condition; confirm later amendments
